newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - May 21.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Foreign Minister John Chang visiting Belgium, France and Austria before heading to Africa
Defence ministry revises military tribunal law to strip military leaders of judgment, approval and case reversal rights
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Military tribunals no longer allowed to handle cases involving death penalty or life imprisonment, cases must be transferred to supreme court
Super concert by Domingo, Carreras and Ross draws 60,000 music lovers
LIBERTY TIMES - National Assembly session turned into street brawl
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank in Japan allegedly involved in making illegal loans to gangsters

China tentatively agrees to allow Taiwan ships to lower flags when entering Hong Kong port in initial period after July 1 if no breakthrough in Taiwan-Hong Kong shipping talks before colony's handover
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to ask private professional institutions to manage its T$350 state funds
Finance Minister Paul Chiu notes that stock index on first anniversary of President Lee Teng-hui's (May 20, 1996) inauguration is 2,000 points higher than a year earlier
